dedupe_keys.name: oil sands monthly royalty rates information 2025 to current

description: Five source packages describe monthly oil-sands royalty rates: pre-payout gross-revenue royalty percentages, post-payout gross-revenue royalty percentages, post-payout net-royalty factors and WTI prices. The inspected PDF descriptors span January 2009–September 2025. The source title for the latest package says 2025 to current, but no later distribution was returned. These are energy-project fiscal parameters, not observed production or actual royalty receipts. Original package identities and monthly publication labels are retained. The source metadata alone does not verify the files, calculation formulas or current statutory applicability. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established. Two additional packages supply the 2017–2020 and 2021–2024 monthly PDF editions of the same named oil-sands royalty publication series. Their 96 monthly descriptors close the previously unreviewed 2017–2024 interval at the metadata level, without validating files or numerical coverage. The 2017–2020 package native end is January 1,2020 while its descriptors extend to December 2020; that conflict remains explicit.
